descriptionChirho: The proper noun Susa (Hebrew שׁוּשַׁן), referring to the ancient capital of Elam and winter residence of the Persian kings. All 21 occurrences denote the same geographical location, whether preceded by the preposition בְּ ('in Susa') or standing alone as a subject or object. The split into two clusters is purely syntactic (prepositional vs. bare form), not semantic. Multilingual evidence is unanimous: eng 'in Susa / Shushan / Susa,' spa 'en Susa / Susa,' hin शूशन में / शूशन, arb في شوشن / شوشن, kor 수산에 / 수산은, swa katika Shushani / Shushani.
